observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage with a wooden floor and red curtains in the background, at a swing dance festival performance in front of a seated audience.
observation.dancers: One couple, a man and a woman.
observation.formation_and_space: Partnered couple dancing in place and traveling across the stage in circles and straight paths.
observation.posture: Upright with a slight forward lean from the hips, knees slightly bent and bouncing on the beat.
observation.footwork: Fast triple steps, kicks, and weight shifts executed rapidly on the beat; cannot see exact foot placements due to camera distance.
observation.arms_and_hands: Closed and open partnering holds, arms swinging naturally or held out for balance during solo moments.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso relatively upright with slight bouncing, hips moving naturally with the footwork and knee action.
observation.partnering: Frequent shifting between closed dance position and open hand-to-hand holds, including spins and a lift.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Jumps, turns, spins, and a high aerial lift where the woman is lifted onto the man's hip.
observation.costume_and_props: Man wears a yellow button-down shirt, brown trousers, flat cap, and sneakers. Woman wears a blue short-sleeve top, beige pleated skirt, and sneakers.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot-to-floor contact and precise weight distribution cannot be determined due to video compression and camera distance.

signature_moments.what: Fast closed-position footwork with rapid knee bouncing and kicks outward.
An aerial lift where the man lifts the woman onto his hip, spinning her around.
